name: Menu Course Sales
query:
SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF(child.custom_course, ''), 'Unassigned / Standalone') AS "Course:Data:150",
    SUM(child.qty) AS "Count:Int:100",
    SUM(child.base_net_amount) AS "Sales Value:Currency:120"
FROM
    `tabPOS Invoice` parent
INNER JOIN
    `tabPOS Invoice Item` child ON child.parent = parent.name
WHERE
    parent.docstatus = 1
    AND parent.posting_date BETWEEN %(start_date)s AND %(end_date)s
    AND parent.branch = %(branch)s
GROUP BY
    COALESCE(NULLIF(child.custom_course, ''), 'Unassigned / Standalone')
ORDER BY
    SUM(child.base_net_amount) DESC
